text.p: Polish computer software firm ComputerLand SA plans a 119,335-share issue to be taken by ComputerLand Europe Operations SA in exchange for the right to continue to operate under its brand, the Polish firm said. statement.

ComputerLand, which had been operating under a franchising agreement with ComputerLand Europe Operations, said in a statement the agreement would be terminated and it would no longer have to pay the franchising fee.
It said the move was expected to lower its costs by about $500,000 this year and boost the expected pre-tax profit by nine percent.
ComputerLand said the new share issue is due to be voted on at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on November 8.
